explication: Couchbase Server is an Erlang OTP application coordinating smart services across a cluster. The principal workflow is: an administrator or client reaches an HTTP, CAPI, or memcached interface; authentication and request dispatch select either cluster control or a data service; services read or mutate bucket state and return results. Cluster management additionally persists configuration, changes topology, and rebalances nodes. The tree and README establish these boundaries, while most Erlang implementation files are unsampled, so uncertain internal call edges are omitted.
